core_invariants: Freeze Wiki-DPR retrieval, Answer Scorer, QORE selection, selected K=5 IDs and order, Generator prompt, evaluator, labels, and baseline Generator.generate.
Only a selected-hit baseline EM error with a successful post-inference gold-answer-copy control is eligible for subset probes.
All 31 non-empty selected-context subsets preserve the original selected order; the full mask reuses the exact frozen baseline outcome.
Gold matching, gold-copy generation, and evaluator results are oracle-only post-inference signals that must never feed selection, retrieval, prompt construction, or decoding.
No selector, Generator, evaluator, retrieval, prompt, label, answer-path, or production mutation is permitted.
Questions, passages, predictions, prompts, gold answers, token IDs, and retrieval IDs remain in memory; result.json contains only scalar and boolean compact fields in exchange.

interfaces.input_schema: question plus frozen Wiki-DPR Top-50 candidates
interfaces.output_schema: ordered frozen QORE plus Answer Scorer selected K=5 context
invariants: one retrieval and selection per question

interfaces.input_schema: in-memory baseline outcome, gold answers, and selected context
interfaces.output_schema: post-inference boolean eligibility and scalar gold-match topology
invariants: requires selected hit, baseline EM zero, and gold-copy EM one
never runs before frozen baseline generation

interfaces.output_schema: 31 ordered non-empty subset outcomes and scalar topology
invariants: full mask aliases the frozen baseline outcome

interfaces.output_schema: strict interaction fractions, bootstrap interval, and report-only gate
invariants: strict interaction requires a successful multi-passage subset with a non-answer-literal member

plugins.insertion_point: after frozen Wiki-DPR plus Answer Scorer plus QORE selection
plugins.hypothesis: The original ordered selected K=5 context is the sole evidence boundary for every arm.
plugins.output_schema: ordered selected K=5 passages retained only in memory
plugins.resource_estimate: one frozen retrieval, Answer Scorer, QORE selection, and baseline generation per question
failure_signatures: selected context differs across probe masks

plugins.hypothesis: A successful copy control isolates questions for which an oracle answer realization is executable.
plugins.input_schema: baseline compact outcome and in-memory gold answers
plugins.output_schema: post-inference eligibility and scalar selected answer-match counts
plugins.resource_estimate: one gold-copy generation only for selected-hit baseline EM errors
failure_signatures: gold or evaluator read before baseline generation

plugins.insertion_point: after post-inference eligibility and before oracle subset generations
plugins.hypothesis: A non-answer-literal selected passage can be jointly necessary with another selected passage even when no singleton context succeeds.
plugins.output_schema: deterministic masks 1 through 31 with original-order contexts
plugins.resource_estimate: 30 additional generations per eligible question because the full-mask outcome aliases frozen baseline generation
failure_signatures: full mask differs from frozen baseline

plugins.hypothesis: EM outcomes distinguish singleton sufficiency, broad distributed support, strict non-answer-assisted support, and beyond-selected-set failure.
plugins.input_schema: in-memory prediction, gold answers, and subset answer-match flags
plugins.output_schema: scalar EM/F1/runtime and boolean topology fields
plugins.resource_estimate: one evaluation per subset generation, all values remain post-inference

plugins.hypothesis: A scalar-only topology summary can pre-register a diagnostic decision without exposing content or changing the baseline.
plugins.input_schema: compact per-question eligibility and subset outcomes
plugins.output_schema: cohort counts, strict interaction bootstrap, and gate decision

composition.merge_rule: One frozen selected K=5 context is generated and evaluated first; only eligible questions enumerate ordered masks, and every compact outcome is summarized after all post-inference probes complete.
interaction_ablations: full-mask outcome aliases frozen baseline outcome
singleton masks versus any multi-passage success
broad distributed success versus strict success containing a non-answer-literal member

validation.baseline_equivalence: The full K=5 mask reuses the exact frozen baseline prediction, metrics, and selected order without a second generation call.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation fixed screen[1800:1850] followed only after gate and user approval by independent replication[1850:1900]
reproducibility.environment: Record resolved generator identity, revision, config hash, evidence/dossier/plan hashes, Python, git revision, and plugin tree hash in run_metadata.json.

full_real_data_l2.formal_data_scope: Any later label-free method must first freeze a complete natural-data formal population; this Phase 10D oracle diagnostic is not that formal evaluation.
full_real_data_l2.data_exposure_policy: Raw compact result.json remains exchange-only; GitHub receives only summary, manifest, hashes, and provenance.
full_real_data_l2.l4_attribution_plan: A later utility method must add matched classical control, independent natural transfer, finite-shot or implementation audit where relevant, and resource accounting before any L4 attribution claim.

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Strict non-answer-assisted distributed-set interaction rate with a question-cluster bootstrap lower bound.

limitations: Phase 10D is an L0, gold-conditioned, post-inference diagnostic and is not a utility intervention.
The gate can only close or justify a separate method portfolio review; it cannot authorize a selector mutation.
A clean null or positive diagnostic does not establish a label-free topology estimator.
